serverOnlyGroups.name: conditions
serverOnlyGroups.reason: Conditions are opaque delegates; the server must decide whether the rule applies.

serverOnlyGroups.name: custom-and-async
serverOnlyGroups.reason: Custom code and asynchronous execution cannot be serialized into a synchronous browser evaluator.

serverOnlyGroups.name: nested-and-collection
serverOnlyGroups.reason: Child validators, collection rules, and included validators require server-side descriptor composition.

serverOnlyGroups.name: cross-field-and-dependent
serverOnlyGroups.reason: Cross-field and dependent rules need the full model and server execution order.

serverOnlyGroups.name: rule-sets-and-templates
serverOnlyGroups.reason: Rule selection and template expansion are host policy and cannot be evaluated in isolation.

serverOnlyGroups.name: domain-reference-data
serverOnlyGroups.reason: These rules use reference data, checksum logic, or policy that belongs on the server.

serverOnlyGroups.name: remaining-descriptor-rules
serverOnlyGroups.reason: These rules are outside the expression-friendly synchronous subset; the server remains authoritative.

serverOnlyGroups.name: unknown-or-future
serverOnlyGroups.reason: Unknown rules are marked serverOnly by the fail-safe default.
